opportunities.title: Dupixent multi-indication standing launch playbook
opportunities.what_happened: Dupixent won a rapid cadence of US approvals — bullous pemphigoid, CSU in patients 12+, and the first biologic for young children with uncontrolled CSU — while representing ~45% of quarterly revenue.
opportunities.evidence: Dupixent approved as the only targeted medicine for bullous pemphigoid; approved for CSU 12+; approved as first biologic for young children with uncontrolled CSU; €5.2bn ~45% of Q2 2026 sales.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A rapid indication cadence multiplies HCP audiences, patient segments and MLR-reviewed assets Sanofi must manage simultaneously.
opportunities.so_what: Each approval opens a distinct commercialization workstream across dermatology, allergy and pediatric audiences.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: A repeatable Omnichannel/MedComm/MLR engagement engine across successive Dupixent launches.
opportunities.next_best_action: Propose a standing indication-launch playbook Company executes on each new Dupixent approval.
opportunities.if_no_action: Indication launches are sourced at the moment of approval, one at a time. With Dupixent at 45% of sales each launch is critical, and incumbents get first call.
opportunities.why_now: Three US approvals have already landed across the indication list. The standing-playbook frame must be set before the next approval.
opportunities.nba_outcome: An approved launch playbook standing ready for the next Dupixent indication.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Company named on successive Dupixent indication launches. The playbook is reused across label expansions with measured throughput.

opportunities.title: Variable-cost capacity partner for the restructuring + 35+ late-stage pipeline
opportunities.what_happened: Sanofi is restructuring with global layoffs after a full pipeline reprioritization funding 35+ late-stage studies by early 2026, targeting up to €2bn savings under Play to Win.
opportunities.evidence: Laying off staff globally following full pipeline reprioritization to fund more than 35 late-stage studies; targeting up to €2bn savings.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Cost optimization plus a swelling late-stage pipeline suggests Sanofi will lean on external partners to absorb variable workload while cutting fixed headcount.
opportunities.so_what: Internal capacity cuts alongside 35+ late-stage studies create outsourcing demand under budget scrutiny.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Position Company as a flexible MedComm/MLR/Regulatory/Omnichannel capacity partner absorbing workload from reduced internal staff.
opportunities.next_best_action: Present a variable-cost capacity model tied to the 35+ late-stage pipeline as headcount is trimmed.
opportunities.if_no_action: The workload from the 35+ studies is absorbed by whoever is already on the roster. Company's existing scope faces scrutiny without a flexible-capacity positioning.
opportunities.why_now: The layoffs are executing now, and the saved headcount is being repurposed into late-stage studies.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A capacity-on-demand model presented against the trimmed headcount plan.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Flexible capacity contracted as the workforce shrinks. Company named in the restructuring-era vendor model.

opportunities.title: Multi-region rare-disease launch excellence (Wayrilz, Qfitlia, Cablivi)
opportunities.what_happened: Sanofi secured first-in-class rare-disease approvals across US, EU and China: Wayrilz (first BTK inhibitor for ITP), Qfitlia (first US therapy for hemophilia A/B), plus Qfitlia and Cablivi in China.
opportunities.evidence: First BTK inhibitor approved in the US for ITP (LUNA 3); first US therapy for hemophilia A or B; Qfitlia and Cablivi approved in China.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A wave of first-in-class rare-disease launches across three regions requires coordinated global-to-local commercialization and market-specific regulatory execution.
opportunities.so_what: Multi-region launches demand localized HCP engagement, medical education and regulatory operations at once.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Greenfield launch opportunities across Omnichannel, MedComm, MLR and Regulatory ops in the US, EU and China.
opportunities.next_best_action: Target the Wayrilz and Qfitlia launches with a global launch-excellence proposal spanning multiple regions.
opportunities.if_no_action: Regional teams source first-in-class launch support independently per market. The multi-region coordination mandate is lost to a partner with broader coverage.
opportunities.why_now: The three-region approval wave is complete, and each local launch team is staffing now.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A single multi-region launch mandate contracted for the rare-disease brands.
opportunities.expected_outcome: At least two regions covered under one Company contract. Localized engagement delivered with a single coordination model.

opportunities.title: Surge capacity for clustered Q2 approvals
opportunities.what_happened: Sanofi delivered seven regulatory approvals, two positive phase 3 studies and four additional designations in Q2 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Pipeline milestones included seven regulatory approvals, two positive phase 3 studies, and four additional regulatory designations.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A dense cadence of approvals implies a heavy near-term launch and label-update workload requiring rapid content, medical and regulatory execution.
opportunities.so_what: Multiple simultaneous approvals create bottleneck risk in launch content and regulatory operations.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Concentrated demand for MLR review, MedComm content and Regulatory operations support.
opportunities.next_best_action: Offer a surge-capacity model for MLR and regulatory launch operations to handle the clustered approval workload.
opportunities.if_no_action: The seven-approval backlog bottlenecks incumbent capacity, and launch dates slip. Surge vendors are picked at the peak when Company is not in the frame.
opportunities.why_now: Seven regulatory approvals all landed in Q2 2026. The approval-to-launch workload is being executed now.
opportunities.nba_outcome: Standby MLR and regulatory capacity contracted for the approval cluster.
opportunities.expected_outcome: The backlog clears without launch-date slippage. Throughput during the cluster is reported to launch leadership.

opportunities.title: Post-Opella pure-play biopharma specialty commercialization
opportunities.what_happened: Sanofi completed the Opella consumer-health separation, receiving €10.4bn net cash and retaining 48.2% of the OPAL JV, confirming a pure-play biopharma pivot.
opportunities.evidence: Sanofi received net cash proceeds of €10.4 billion; retained 48.2% equity interest in OPAL JV Co holding Opella.
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Freed capital and a sharpened biopharma focus concentrate investment on innovative-medicine launches and pipeline assets.
opportunities.so_what: A pure-play Sanofi with fresh capital intensifies focus on specialty and rare-disease commercialization.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Directly maps to Company's core specialty-launch service territory.
opportunities.next_best_action: Position Company services against Sanofi's post-Opella specialty commercialization needs.
opportunities.if_no_action: Redeployed capital funds specialty launches with incumbents already in the franchises. Company stays outside the pure-play agenda the separation created.
opportunities.why_now: The EUR 10.4 billion separation is complete, and capital redeployment decisions are being made this year.
opportunities.nba_outcome: A specialty-launch engagement plan built around the pure-play pivot.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Specialty-launch scope won under the pure-play strategy. Company named in redeployment-funded launch planning.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: Life-sciences-specialized AI partnership before disintermediation
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: Sanofi is building a proprietary AI ecosystem (Snowflake/ElementumAI; earlier Formation Bio and OpenAI) to become the first biopharma powered by AI at scale.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: Sanofi building its own AI ecosystem including data partnerships; earlier collaboration to build AI-powered software; path to first biopharma powered by AI at scale.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: An in-house, partnership-driven AI strategy could crowd out generic analytics vendors or create demand for domain-specialized AI implementation partners.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: Sanofi's AI-first posture is both a competitive threat and an opening for domain-specialized partners.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company must position DAAI/Tech Solutions as a life-sciences-specialized AI partner for commercialization use cases or risk being designed out of the AI stack.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Develop a DAAI/Tech Solutions POV on complementing Sanofi's proprietary AI with commercialization-specific AI use cases.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: The proprietary ecosystem absorbs commercialization AI in-house, and Company is designed out of the stack. Recovering the position later costs more than earning it now.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: Sanofi's ecosystem push is current, and the AI partner map is being drawn while the stack is still open.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: A positioning brief on commercialization-specific AI use cases that fit Sanofi's internal stack.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Company engaged on a commercialization AI pilot while the ecosystem is still open. The next review benchmarks Company as a domain-specialized partner.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: Direct-to-patient engagement for the TrumpRx.gov channel
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: Sanofi agreed with the US government to align Medicaid prices with other high-income countries (~61% lower), enable direct-to-patient access via TrumpRx.gov, and secure a three-year Section 232 tariff exemption.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: Medicaid prices to align with other high-income countries (avg 61% lower); direct-to-patient access via TrumpRx.gov; three-year Section 232 tariff exemption.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A direct-to-patient channel and steep Medicaid cuts reshape US access, pricing and patient-engagement models, requiring new commercial and patient-support workflows.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: The deal forces new direct-to-patient engagement capabilities Sanofi must operationalize.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Creates demand for Company patient-engagement, access and Omnichannel support — a workstream Company may not currently serve.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Develop a direct-to-patient engagement and access-support offer aligned to the TrumpRx.gov channel and revised pricing.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: TrumpRx.gov workflows are built by incumbents already in the access space. The patient-engagement domain the agreement creates closes before Company enters.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: The government agreement is signed, and channel workflows are being designed this cycle.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: An engagement and access-support proposal framed around the new direct-to-patient channel.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Company supporting the channel before workflows harden. Patient-engagement scope won under the revised pricing model.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: Vaccines demand-generation to reverse US softness
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: Q2 2026 vaccines sales were ~€1.1bn, down 4.7%, reflecting continued US vaccine demand softness.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: Vaccines sales approximately €1.1 billion, down 4.7%, reflecting continued softness in US vaccine demand.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Persistent US vaccine weakness may prompt Sanofi to rethink demand-generation tactics, including patient and HCP activation.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: A declining segment needs sharper demand-generation rather than status-quo spend.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: An opening for Company Omnichannel and DAAI demand-generation and adherence analytics — at risk of going to a competitor if not pursued.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Offer a vaccines demand-generation and HCP activation analytics proposal targeting the softening US segment.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: A competitor takes the demand-generation mandate while the US vaccines decline continues. The reversal Company could have driven is claimed by another vendor.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: The Q2 2026 print confirmed the vaccines decline, and Sanofi is shaping its response now.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: An HCP activation and demand-generation program proposed for the US vaccines business.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: A demand-generation program running against the softening US segment. Decline-trend and activation metrics tracked in the program.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: Tolebrutinib CRL remediation and resubmission support
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for tolebrutinib in non-relapsing secondary progressive MS in December 2025.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: FDA issued a complete response letter for tolebrutinib in non-relapsing secondary progressive multiple sclerosis.
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A CRL typically requires additional data/analyses and resubmission, extending timelines and heightening dossier scrutiny.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: Sanofi must rework its regulatory strategy and submission, creating remediation workload.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: A direct entry point for Company Regulatory ops to support CRL response, dossier remediation and resubmission.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Proactively offer Regulatory-affairs support for CRL response and resubmission planning on tolebrutinib.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: Sanofi's remediation bench is already set inside the regulatory function. Without a proposal the recovery runs entirely without Company.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: The CRL landed in December 2025, and remediation resourcing decisions are live now.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: A resubmission support scope agreed with the tolebrutinib regulatory team.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Resubmission support contracted before the FDA response is finalized. Company referenced in the remediation tracker.
